title: Read snapshot observations response
description: Plan lifecycle API route schema (FinancialPlanning platform; added in contracts 0.2.0, design D13). Response of GET /v1/snapshots/{input_snapshot_id}/observations: the tools/query-market-data-response summary plus one page of committed observations, the requested range, the parts of it the snapshot does not cover and the sessions it is missing. Nothing is fabricated: uncovered ranges and missing sessions are stated, never filled.
